Every server ran from that folder through /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/U/launch.py. I unlocked only through the real #pw/#btn-unlock form: first a wrong passphrase (the expected 403), then the right one. lock-state then read unlocked-encrypted.

- empty_fr on 9633

I used the app's own sqlcipher3 driver with PRAGMA key and the file's 16384 cipher page size (script seed_flagged.py). /api/law/documents then returned revisions 1, flagged 1 for that row. No other data was touched by hand.
